programs.source: class Invalid < StandardError end class Editor ARITIES = { "LIST" => [0], "VALIDATE" => [0], "SEARCH" => [1], "AT" => [1], "GAPS" => [1], "STATS" => [0], "PRINT" => [0], "TOVTT" => [0], "TOASS" => [0], "FRAMES" => [1], "SHIFT" => [1], "SHIFTFROM" => [2], "SCALE" => [2], "SYNC" => [4], "SNAP" => [1], "FIXOVERLAP" => [1], "EXTEND" => [1], "TIME" => [3], "SORT" => [0], "RENUMBER" => [0], "MERGE" => [1], "SPLIT" => [1], "INSERT" => [4], "DELETE" => [1, 2], "TEXT" => [2], "BALANCE" => [0], "STRIP" => [0], "CLEANHI" => [0], "REPLACE" => [1], "UNDO" => [0] }.freeze MODIFYING = %w[SHIFT SHIFTFROM SCALE SYNC SNAP FIXOVERLAP EXTEND TIME SORT RENUMBER MERGE SPLIT INSERT DELETE TEXT BALANCE STRIP CLEANHI REPLACE].freeze FORMATS = %w[ ].freeze def initialize @cues = [] @history = [] end def bad raise Invalid, "bad arguments" end def integer(value, minimum = 0, maximum = 999_999_999) bad unless value.match?(/\A\d{1,9}\z/) result = value.to_i bad unless result.between?(minimum, maximum) result end def signed(value) bad unless value.match?(/\A-?\d{1,9}\z/) value.to_i end def parse_time(value) bad unless value.match?(/\A\d{2}:[0-5]\d:[0-5]\d,\d{3}\z/) value[0, 2].to_i * 3_600_000 + value[3, 2].to_i * 60_000 + value[6, 2].to_i * 1000 + value[9, 3].to_i end def fps(value) parts = value.split("/", -1) bad if parts.length > 2 [integer(parts[0], 1, 100_000), parts.length == 2 ? integer(parts[1], 1, 100_000) : 1] end def text_lines(value) parts = value.split("|", -1) bad if parts.empty? || parts.any?(&:empty?) parts end def rounded(a, b) if b.negative? a = -a b = -b end (2 * a + b).div(2 * b) end def srt(time) format("%02d:%02d:%02d,%03d", time.div(3_600_000), time.div(60_000) % 60, time.div(1000) % 60, time % 1000) end def ass(time) c = (time + 5).div(10) format("%d:%02d:%02d.%02d", c.div(360_000), c.div(6000) % 60, c.div(100) % 60, c % 100) end def decimal(value) format("%d.%02d", value.div(100), value % 100) end def chars(cue) cue[:text].sum(&:length) end def dialogue?(cue) cue[:text].any? { |line| line.start_with?("- ") } end def words(lines) lines.join(" ").split(" ") end def wrap(lines, width) result = [] words(lines).each do |word| if !result.empty? && result[-1].length + 1 + word.length <= width result[-1] += " " + word else result << word end end result end def markup(line) result = [] p = 0 while p < line.length tag = FORMATS.find { |item| line[p, item.length] == item } if tag result << { kind: :format, text: tag, digit: 0 } p += tag.length next end font = nil if line[p, 7] == "" font = "" elsif line[p, 5] == ""].include?(line[p + 5]) ending = line.index(">", p + 5) font = line[p..ending] if ending end if font result << { kind: :font, text: font, digit: 0 } p += font.length next end position = /\A\{\\an([1-9])\}/.match(line[p..]) if position result << { kind: :position, text: position[0], digit: position[1].to_i } p += position[0].length else result << { kind: :char, text: line[p], digit: 0 } p += 1 end end result end def listing(cue, position) "#{position} #{cue[:index]} #{srt(cue[:start])} #{srt(cue[:end])} " + cue[:text].join("|") end def load(lines) blocks = [] current = [] (lines + [""]).each do |line| if !line.empty? current << line elsif !current.empty? blocks << current current = [] end end output = [] blocks.each_with_index do |block, i| reason = nil if !block[0].match?(/\A\d{1,6}\z/) reason = "index" elsif block.length < 2 || !block[1].match?(/\A\d{2}:[0-5]\d:[0-5]\d,\d{3} --> \d{2}:[0-5]\d:[0-5]\d,\d{3}\z/) reason = "time" elsif block.length < 3 reason = "no text" end if reason output << "BAD CUE #{i + 1}: #{reason}" else @cues << { index: block[0].to_i, start: parse_time(block[1][0, 12]), end: parse_time(block[1][17, 12]), text: block[2..] } end end output << "LOAD cues=#{@cues.length} bad=#{blocks.length - @cues.length}" output end def execute(line) name = line.split(" ", 2)[0] raise Invalid, "unknown command" unless ARITIES.key?(name) fixed = { "SEARCH" => 0, "INSERT" => 3, "TEXT" => 1, "REPLACE" => 0 } if fixed.key?(name) bad if line.length <= name.length args = [] p = name.length + 1 fixed[name].times do following = line.index(" ", p) bad unless following args << line[p...following] p = following + 1 end args << line[p..] else args = line.split(" ")[1..] end bad unless ARITIES[name].include?(args.length) values = [] texts = [] rate = [1, 1] old = "" replacement = "" positions = [] position = lambda do |value| p = integer(value, 1) positions << p p end case name when "AT" values << parse_time(args[0]) when "GAPS", "FIXOVERLAP", "MERGE" values << integer(args[0], 0, 60_000) when "EXTEND" values << integer(args[0], 1, 60_000) when "SPLIT" values << integer(args[0], 10, 80) when "SHIFT" values << signed(args[0]) when "SHIFTFROM" values = [position.call(args[0]), signed(args[1])] when "SCALE" values = args.map { |arg| integer(arg, 1, 100_000) } when "SYNC" values = [position.call(args[0]), parse_time(args[1]), position.call(args[2]), parse_time(args[3])] when "TIME", "INSERT" values = [position.call(args[0]), parse_time(args[1]), parse_time(args[2])] texts = text_lines(args[3]) if name == "INSERT" when "DELETE" values = args.map { |arg| position.call(arg) } bad if values.length == 2 && values[1] < values[0] when "TEXT" values = [position.call(args[0])] texts = text_lines(args[1]) when "FRAMES", "SNAP" rate = fps(args[0]) when "REPLACE" parts = args[0].split("|", -1) bad unless parts.length == 2 && parts.none?(&:empty?) old, replacement = parts end positions.each do |p| limit = @cues.length + (name == "INSERT" ? 1 : 0) raise Invalid, "no cue #{p}" if p > limit end if name == "SYNC" && @cues[values[0] - 1][:start] == @cues[values[2] - 1][:start] raise Invalid, "sync points coincide" end if name == "UNDO" record = @history.pop raise Invalid, "nothing to undo" unless record @cues = record[:cues] return ["UNDO command=#{record[:name]}"] end if MODIFYING.include?(name) snapshot = @cues.map { |cue| cue.merge(text: cue[:text].dup) } @history << { name: name, cues: snapshot } end process(name, args, values, texts, rate, old, replacement) end def process(name, args, v, texts, rate, old, replacement) output = [] n = @cues.length case name when "LIST", "AT" @cues.each_with_index do |cue, i| if name == "LIST" || (cue[:start] <= v[0] && v[0] < cue[:end]) output << listing(cue, i + 1) end end output << "AT active=#{output.length}" if name == "AT" when "VALIDATE" @cues.each_with_index do |cue, i| p = i + 1 prefix = "cue #{p}: " d = cue[:end] - cue[:start] output << prefix + "index #{cue[:index]} (expected #{p})" if cue[:index] != p output << prefix + "end not after start" if d <= 0 if i.positive? && cue[:start] < @cues[i - 1][:end] output << prefix + "overlaps previous by #{@cues[i - 1][:end] - cue[:start]} ms" end if d.between?(1, 699) output << prefix + "too short (#{d} ms)" elsif d > 7000 output << prefix + "too long (#{d} ms)" end cue[:text].each_with_index do |text, j| output << prefix + "line #{j + 1} too long (#{text.length} chars)" if text.length > 42 end output << prefix + "too many lines (#{cue[:text].length})" if cue[:text].length >= 3 c = chars(cue) if d.positive? && c * 1000 > 21 * d output << prefix + "too fast (#{decimal((c * 100_000).div(d))} cps)" end end output << "VALIDATE problems=#{output.length}" when "SEARCH" @cues.each_with_index do |cue, i| match = cue[:text].find { |text| text.include?(args[0]) } output << "#{i + 1} #{srt(cue[:start])} #{match}" if match end output << "SEARCH found=#{output.length}" when "GAPS" (0...n - 1).each do |i| gap = @cues[i + 1][:start] - @cues[i][:end] output << "#{i + 1} #{i + 2} #{gap}" if gap < v[0] end output << "GAPS count=#{output.length}" when "STATS" output << "STATS cues=#{n}" if n.positive? durations = @cues.map { |cue| [0, cue[:end] - cue[:start]].max } total = durations.sum c = @cues.each_with_index.sum { |cue, i| durations[i].positive? ? chars(cue) : 0 } output << "duration total=#{srt(total)} mean=#{srt(total.div(n))}" output << "speed " + (total.positive? ? decimal((c * 100_000).div(total)) : "-") maximum = durations.max output << "longest cue=#{durations.index(maximum) + 1} duration=#{srt(maximum)}" if n == 1 output << "gap none" else gaps = @cues.drop(1).each_with_index.map { |cue, i| cue[:start] - @cues[i][:end] } maximum_gap = gaps.max output << "gap cue=#{gaps.index(maximum_gap) + 1} ms=#{maximum_gap}" end end when "PRINT" @cues.each do |cue| output.concat([cue[:index].to_s, "#{srt(cue[:start])} --> #{srt(cue[:end])}", *cue[:text], ""]) end when "TOVTT" output.concat(["WEBVTT", ""]) escapes = { "&" => "&", "<" => "<", ">" => ">" } @cues.each do |cue| digit = 0 converted = cue[:text].map do |line| result = +"" markup(line).each do |token| digit = token[:digit] if token[:kind] == :position && digit.zero? if token[:kind] == :format result << token[:text] elsif token[:kind] == :char result << escapes.fetch(token[:text], token[:text]) end end result.strip end.reject(&:empty?) next if converted.empty? settings = digit >= 7 ? " line:0" : digit >= 4 ? " line:50%" : "" settings += " align:start" if [1, 4, 7].include?(digit) settings += " align:end" if [3, 6, 9].include?(digit) timing = "#{srt(cue[:start]).tr(',', '.')} --> #{srt(cue[:end]).tr(',', '.')}#{settings}" output.concat([cue[:index].to_s, timing, *converted, ""]) end when "TOASS" output.concat(["[Events]", "Format: Layer, Start, End, Style, Name, MarginL, MarginR, MarginV, Effect, Text"]) tags = { "" => "{\\i1}", "" => "{\\i0}", "" => "{\\b1}", "" => "{\\b0}", "" => "{\\u1}", "" => "{\\u0}" } @cues.each do |cue| converted = cue[:text].map do |line| markup(line).map do |token| if token[:kind] == :format tags[token[:text]] elsif token[:kind] == :font "" else token[:text] end end.join end output << "Dialogue: 0,#{ass(cue[:start])},#{ass(cue[:end])},Default,,0,0,0,," + converted.join("\\N") end when "FRAMES" @cues.each_with_index do |cue, i| frames = [cue[:start], cue[:end]].map { |t| (t * rate[0]).div(1000 * rate[1]) } output << "#{i + 1} #{frames[0]} #{frames[1]}" end when "SHIFT", "SHIFTFROM", "SCALE", "SYNC", "SNAP" clamped = 0 changed = 0 first = name == "SHIFTFROM" ? v[0] - 1 : 0 shift = name == "SHIFTFROM" ? v[1] : v[0] s1 = name == "SYNC" ? @cues[v[0] - 1][:start] : 0 s2 = name == "SYNC" ? @cues[v[2] - 1][:start] : 0 (first...n).each do |i| cue = @cues[i] was_clamped = false %i[start end].each do |key| t = cue[key] result = case name when "SHIFT", "SHIFTFROM" t + shift when "SCALE" rounded(t * v[0], v[1]) when "SYNC" den = s2 - s1 rounded(v[1] * den + (t - s1) * (v[3] - v[1]), den) else frame = rounded(t * rate[0], 1000 * rate[1]) rounded(frame * 1000 * rate[1], rate[0]) end if result.negative? was_clamped = true result = 0 end changed += 1 if result != t cue[key] = result end clamped += 1 if was_clamped end output << if name == "SNAP" "SNAP changed=#{changed}" elsif name == "SCALE" "SCALE cues=#{n}" else "#{name} cues=#{n - first} clamped=#{clamped}" end when "FIXOVERLAP" fixed = 0 failed = 0 (0...n - 1).each do |i| cue = @cues[i] limit = @cues[i + 1][:start] - v[0] next unless cue[:end] > limit if limit > cue[:start] cue[:end] = limit fixed += 1 else failed += 1 output << "cue #{i + 1}: cannot fix" end end output << "FIXOVERLAP fixed=#{fixed} failed=#{failed}" when "EXTEND" extended = 0 @cues.each_with_index do |cue, i| next unless cue[:end] - cue[:start] < v[0] candidate = cue[:start] + v[0] candidate = [candidate, @cues[i + 1][:start]].min if i + 1 < n if candidate > cue[:end] cue[:end] = candidate extended += 1 end end short = @cues.count { |cue| cue[:end] - cue[:start] < v[0] } output << "EXTEND extended=#{extended} short=#{short}" when "TIME" @cues[v[0] - 1][:start] = v[1] @cues[v[0] - 1][:end] = v[2] output << "TIME cue=#{v[0]}" when "SORT" sorted = @cues.each_with_index.sort_by { |cue, i| [cue[:start], cue[:end], i] } moved = sorted.each_with_index.count { |(_, old_position), i| old_position != i } @cues = sorted.map(&:first) output << "SORT moved=#{moved}" when "RENUMBER" changed = 0 @cues.each_with_index do |cue, i| if cue[:index] != i + 1 cue[:index] = i + 1 changed += 1 end end output << "RENUMBER changed=#{changed}" when "MERGE" merged = [] joins = 0 @cues.each do |cue| previous = merged[-1] lines = previous ? wrap(previous[:text] + cue[:text], 42) : [] if previous && cue[:start] - previous[:end] < v[0] && !dialogue?(previous) && !dialogue?(cue) && lines.length <= 2 previous[:end] = [previous[:end], cue[:end]].max previous[:text] = lines joins += 1 else merged << cue end end @cues = merged output << "MERGE merged=#{joins} cues=#{merged.length}" when "SPLIT" result = [] split = 0 @cues.each do |cue| duration = cue[:end] - cue[:start] if duration <= 0 || dialogue?(cue) result << cue next end lines = wrap(cue[:text], v[0]) if lines.length <= 2 cue[:text] = lines result << cue next end split += 1 parts = lines.each_slice(2).to_a counts = parts.map { |part| part.sum(&:length) } total = counts.sum times = counts.map { |c| (duration * c).div(total) } order = counts.each_index.sort_by { |i| [-(duration * counts[i] % total), i] } (duration - times.sum).times { |i| times[order[i]] += 1 } start = cue[:start] parts.each_with_index do |text, i| result << { index: cue[:index], start: start, end: start + times[i], text: text } start += times[i] end end @cues = result output << "SPLIT split=#{split} cues=#{result.length}" when "INSERT" @cues.insert(v[0] - 1, { index: v[0], start: v[1], end: v[2], text: texts }) output << "INSERT cue=#{v[0]} cues=#{@cues.length}" when "DELETE" count = (v[1] || v[0]) - v[0] + 1 @cues.slice!(v[0] - 1, count) output << "DELETE removed=#{count} cues=#{@cues.length}" when "TEXT" @cues[v[0] - 1][:text] = texts output << "TEXT cue=#{v[0]} lines=#{texts.length}" when "BALANCE" changed = 0 skipped = 0 dialogues = 0 @cues.each do |cue| if dialogue?(cue) dialogues += 1 next end all = words(cue[:text]) joined = all.join(" ") best = joined.length <= 42 ? [joined] : nil unless best (1...all.length).each do |j| candidate = [all.take(j).join(" "), all.drop(j).join(" ")] next if candidate.any? { |text| text.length > 42 } key = [(candidate[0].length - candidate[1].length).abs, candidate[0].length] best_key = best && [(best[0].length - best[1].length).abs, best[0].length] best = candidate if best.nil? || (key <=> best_key).negative? end end if best.nil? skipped += 1 elsif best != cue[:text] cue[:text] = best changed += 1 end end output << "BALANCE changed=#{changed} skipped=#{skipped} dialogue=#{dialogues}" when "STRIP", "CLEANHI" tags = 0 segments = 0 labels = 0 deleted_lines = 0 result = [] @cues.each do |cue| lines = [] cue[:text].each do |original| line = +"" if name == "STRIP" markup(original).each do |token| if token[:kind] == :char line << token[:text] else tags += 1 end end line = line.strip else line = original.gsub(/\[.*?\]|\(.*?\)/) do segments += 1 "" end line = line.gsub(/ +/, " ").strip prefix = line.start_with?("- ") ? "- " : "" body = line[prefix.length..] colon = body.index(":") if colon && body[0...colon].match?(/\A[A-Z][A-Z0-9 ]*\z/) labels += 1 line = (prefix + body[colon + 1..]).gsub(/ +/, " ").strip end end if line.empty? || (name == "CLEANHI" && line == "-") deleted_lines += 1 else lines << line end end unless lines.empty? cue[:text] = lines result << cue end end @cues = result suffix = " removed_lines=#{deleted_lines} removed_cues=#{n - result.length}" output << if name == "STRIP" "STRIP tags=#{tags}" + suffix else "CLEANHI segments=#{segments} labels=#{labels}" + suffix end when "REPLACE" count = 0 changed = 0 @cues.each do |cue| matches = 0 cue[:text] = cue[:text].map do |line| parts = line.split(old, -1) matches += parts.length - 1 parts.join(replacement) end count += matches changed += 1 if matches.positive? end output << "REPLACE count=#{count} cues=#{changed}" end output end end lines = STDIN.read.split("\n", -1) terminator = lines.index("###") editor = Editor.new output = editor.load(lines.take(terminator)) count = lines[terminator + 1].to_i count.times do |i| begin output.concat(editor.execute(lines[terminator + 2 + i])) rescue Invalid => error output << "ERROR " + error.message end end STDOUT.write(output.join("\n") + "\n")
